tagline: Make hotel travel possible for all
hero_kpi_rationale: RevPAR (revenue per available room) is the key performance indicator for the hotel franchise. It reflects the ability to generate revenue and maintain high occupancy across a portfolio of 8,300+ affiliated hotels.

kpis.name: Revenue per Available Room
kpis.description: RevPAR is calculated by multiplying the average occupancy rate by the average daily rate

kpis.name: Royalty and Franchise Fee Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from royalties and franchise fees from affiliated hotels
kpis.description: Revenue from franchise agreements with third-party hotel owners, calculated by dividing total royalties by the average exchange rate

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: EBITDA adjusted for non-recurring expenses and extraordinary items
kpis.description: Operational performance measure excluding interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, extraordinary items (Revo charges of $160M), and non-recurring items

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of €1.43B in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income

kpis.name: Total Assets

kpis.name: Total Debt

kpis.name: Revenue per Available Room in 2025
kpis.explanation: Average revenue per available room in 2025
kpis.description: RevPAR reflects the performance of affiliated hotels' revenue generation, impacted by changes in occupancy rates and average rates

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattack risks. The report states that the company is not currently aware of material risks, but acknowledges there is no guarantee such risks will not materialize in the future.

risks.title: Insolvency of Franchise Partners
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded charges of $160 million in 2025 due to the insolvency of the large European franchisee Revo Hospitality Group ($86M in impairments and $74M in operating expenses).

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive hotel franchising sector with 25 brands positioned in economy, midscale, and upper-midscale segments. However, no specific information on competitive risks is provided.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in approximately 100 countries and is subject to strict regulations regarding personal data protection and contractual compliance.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The technology platform supports the global network of 8,300+ hotels and 869,000 rooms. A technical failure or cyberattack could impact bookings and operations.

ai_positioning.summary: Company WH does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F report for the 2025 fiscal year.
